Appearance:

Shri Raghuveer Prajapati - Panel Lawyer for responden

Order 
This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of B.N.S.S./439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.265/2023, registered at Police Station - Kotwali, District Annupur (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 376 and 376 (2) of IPC.

Applicant is in detention since 5.3.2025.
2.

As per the prosecution story, the allegation against the applicant is that on the false promise of marriage, the applicant has developed physical relation with the prosecutrix and later on he refused to marry her.
On the complaint of the prosecutrix, offence was registered against the applicant under aforesaid sections.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.
He is in custody since 5.3.2025.
It is submitted that the prosecutrix is aged about 27 years and is also a married NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:30727 2 MCRC-22074-2025 woman.
Charge sheet has been filed.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant may be released on bail.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for State has opposed the grant of bail to the applicant and prayed for it's rejection.
5. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on merit of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.

Consequently, bail application under Section 483 of BNSS/439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant,
Akash Nat@Natraj vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/70065210/
1 stands allowed.

sentences.text: 6. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of BNSS.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
